culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Itaru Kaburagi. He confesses about Tomari's real identity as a marriage swindler Ari Sukiyama. She tricked his good-nature older brother into supporting her, before leaving him with a huge debt that drove him to suicide. He also reveals her ways of finding potential victims: Tomari waited outside for a long time before entering the party, this was because she was waiting for someone to slip and fall since their expensive leather shoes were prone to slipping. On other occasions when it is not rainy, she would simply pour water on the floor. Kaburagi takes the knife from the cart
